about_the_game:
Become the best chef in the world!

In Kitchen Quest you can prepare over 50 delicious dishes - in your own fully equipped dream kitchen! From frying pans to deep fryers, everything a real chef needs is included. And don't forget: Your restaurant should be just as impressive as your food - otherwise guests will leave before you can even serve them.

Everything a chef's heart desires

Your kitchen has more than 50 different ingredients for you to get creative with. Cook, fry, bake and surprise your guests with a varied menu that leaves nothing to be desired.

Watch out, the kitchen may catch fire!

But be warned: in the hustle and bustle of a real professional kitchen, things can quickly go wrong. A steak on the grill for too long? You've got a problem! In Kitchen Quest, every second counts - and your guests have little patience.

Critical guests, real challenges

Customers are merciless in their judgement. A late order or a dish that doesn't meet their expectations will have an immediate impact on your rating. Some never give you a second chance, others remain silent - but don't come back. Learn to deal with pressure and keep improving your restaurant.

The critics are coming!

Invite up to 7 different restaurant critics to take your restaurant to the next level. If they like your food, they'll share their secret favourite recipes with you - which you can then sell yourself.

Fancy cooking without the stress?

Then sandbox mode is just the thing. All recipes are unlocked immediately, you can take your time to embellish your restaurant - and annoying guests who run away because of every little thing stay outside. Perfect for creative, relaxed play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (x64)
  • Processor: i5 3550
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (x64)
  • Processor: i5 4570
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
